Maximally entangled necessary test gives exact trace budget including all R+K anomalies. Inherited l2 residual and lambda1 bounds apply before bounded-c assumptions; clipping has the stated exact signed trace increment.

Bounded head gain and global active-branch derivative lower bound force c bounded for every potentially winning state uniformly in all D>=delta0 m^3. Only afterward are relative error bounds proportional to c used; no bounded-aspect restriction or tiny-anomaly cutoff is introduced.

For any fixed positive delta<d the same single-profile construction gives strictly positive limiting profit, proving E1. Fixed-m credited crossings prove onset existence for each m>=3.
